channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.7

Opening notes offline no longer shows a summary network error.

  • Cache Enhanced summaries when you open a note online.
  • Reuse that cache offline instead of failing the summaries request.
  • Generate and edit still need internet, with calm “Requires internet” copy.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.6

Your notes stay available with no internet — Granola-style offline access.

  • Relaunch offline and go straight into your cached notes (no login wall).
  • Folders work offline alongside note text.
  • Calm offline indicator instead of error banners.
  • Calendar and Ask Anything show clear offline states.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.5

Smoother calendar connect, settings, and Ask Anything.

  • Google Calendar connect uses the same success page and opens the app automatically.
  • Settings no longer shows Ask Anything or calendar events on top of the page.
  • Ask Anything keeps the reply thread open after an answer lands.
  • Less flicker when switching back to ThisWeek from another app.
